g.text: Managed Multi-Agent Session and Context Assembly
with Upgrade and existing auth context
validate existing private-key or JWT auth
and capture same-Pod cursor plus snapshot
subscribe to events() after response write
native Skill summaries, and cwd only.
Pool retains AgentSession and the active-run reference; transport only subscribes.
AgentSession and AgentLoop execute; Hub maintains recovery state.
User-IP affinity is not a distributed owner.
Pod restart rebuilds from the database and marks the old run interrupted.
